name: Gearbox
text: Run EXCAVA’s core reasoning on the latest Llama 3.4 405B Instruct. It’s the strongest open model available today, and its 405B parameter scale delivers measurable gains over smaller models—even a 0.5% lift is plausible. The trade-off is cost: this model is expensive to run, but the potential capability boost justifies it for high-value tasks.

name: Torque
text: Llama 3.4 405B’s 120ms latency hit will break EXCAVA’s real-time pipeline—no 0.5% gain matters if frames drop. Test the model on a live pipeline slice first; if latency stays under 50ms, proceed, else default to the proven 3.7 Sonnet with its fragile but stable 0.7% gain.
